title: Letter to Quorum of the Twelve, 4 August 1835
source_note: Council of presidencies and others (including JS), Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to Quorum of the Twelve, [Saco, York Co., ME], 4 Aug. 1835. Retained copy, [ca. 4 Aug. 1835], in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 90–93; handwriting of John Whitmer; JS Collection, CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
